html:
Ciudad del Este is a city in eastern Paraguay on the Paraná River, founded in 1957 and named after the dictator Stroessner until 1989. It became one of the largest free markets of South America.

It was founded to open Paraguay towards Brazil and the Atlantic. The Friendship Bridge to Brazil opened in 1965, and the building of the Itaipu Dam nearby brought workers and money. With low taxes, the city filled with shops selling electronics and goods to Brazilian and Argentine shoppers, legally and through smuggling.

It sits at the Triple Frontier with Brazil and Argentina, near the Iguazu Falls, and has large Arab and Chinese communities. It grew into Paraguay's second city, a symbol of the trade economy built under Stroessner.
sum: Ciudad del Este is a city in eastern Paraguay on the Paraná River, founded in 1957 and named after the dictator Stroessner until 1989. It became one of the largest free markets of South America.
